Using the determinant formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}u\times v & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ 6 & -2 & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & -3\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 \\ 0 & -3\end{aligned}|i-|\begin{aligned}6 & 0 \\ 5 & -3\end{aligned}|j+|\begin{aligned}6 & -2 \\ 5 & 0\end{aligned}|k \\  & =((-2)\cdot (-3)-0\cdot 0)i-(6\cdot (-3)-0\cdot 5)j+(6\cdot 0-(-2)\cdot 5)k \\  & =(6-0)i-(-18-0)j+(0-(-10))k \\  & =6i+18j+10k \\  & =⟨6,18,10⟩.\end{aligned}
$$
